newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Fat man sues over dental discrimination in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Fat man sues over dental discrimination in Brazil.

text.p: A Brazilian man has initiated legal proceedings against a dentist who refused to treat him because he was fat, a television station reported on Tuesday.

"He said he would not treat me because his chair might break," 320-pound (145 kg) Ronaldo Bertolotti told SBT television. He filed a complaint with a police station in Maringa, Parana state, citing discrimination.
But the dentist said he was only concerned about Bertolotti's safety. "I didn't want to treat him because I was worried that if the chair broke, he might have hurt himself," Antonio de Castro said.
